visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a black and white plaid shirt over a grey crop top, sits indoors. She holds a white makeup compact in her left hand and a sponge in her right, looking into the mirror. A hand enters from the right, reaching toward her face. (2) The hand presses against her face, specifically pushing her nose upwards with a thumb, distorting her facial features. She looks at the camera and laughs, her mouth open, showing her teeth. Yellow text with parentheses appears in the center-left. (3) The scene shifts to a close-up of the woman's face as the hand continues to push her nose up. Black circles are edited over her nostrils to emphasize them. A white charging adapter is then placed over the printed image of her nose. (4) The camera cuts to the woman standing in an office setting. She wears a blue striped apron over a light blue shirt. An animated fire border surrounds the frame. She stares at the camera with a slight, knowing smile. (5) The woman walks away from the camera in the office, passing desks where other people are working. The fire border remains. The camera follows her movement as she turns slightly. (6) A man with short black hair and glasses appears, holding a printed photo of the girl with the charging block on her nose. He smiles and speaks directly to the camera against a plain white background.
